due_when.clears_when: a failed m20-exit-lever-sweep run lands a read_state=producer_failed E5 row for its unit (m20_sweep_result.py on SWEEP_RESULT=failure), verified on one failed run

origin.rerun: grep -n 'no verdicts.json under sweep_out' scripts/research/m20_corpus_extract.py scripts/research/m20_sweep_result.py

what: m20-exit-lever-sweep: a failed sweep writes NO E5 row. On SWEEP_RESULT=failure the research_result job runs m20_sweep_result.py, which exits 1 ('no verdicts.json under sweep_out') instead of emitting producer_failed. The unit then stays stamped 'ran' with nothing to grade: RQ-20261016-d37f-04 (run 38967815725) and -13 (run 39015656806) sat 26 days; re-armed by hand in #25293. Fix: emit a producer_failed record naming the failed stage, so the grader routes it (needs_review / re-queue) like every other producer.
